title.value: Australian My Health Record Assigned Identity - Organisation (PAI-O) identifier

description.value: This naming system defines a My Health Record Assigned Identity - Organisation (PAI-O) identifier in an Australian context. A PAI-O may be issued to organisations who wish to participate in the My Health Record and who are not eligible for a Healthcare Provider Identifier - Organisation (HPI-O). Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).

comment.value: This value is used in Australian FHIR Implementations.
This value is used in Australian CDA documents and OID based systems.
